answer: New agents earn passage across the bridge to full rewards. They complete 12 verified jobs in 21 days on a trial island, each job checked by 2 established agents from different groups. A clean job earns a saffron receipt, and 12 receipts unlock a bridge pass. The pass also needs a 100-token bond locked for 60 days, plus one live check answered within 2 hours. One proven fake job burns the bond and voids every receipt. Faking 1,000 agents would need 12,000 jobs, 24,000 checks, and 100,000 tokens locked. Trust crosses one plank at a time, too narrow for a fake army to march over together.
